text:
Alex: Quick sync  planning a compact paid push this weekend to drive webinar RSVPs (Jun 2) + seed high-quality retarget audiences. Objectives: 200 RSVPs, 600 mid-funnel retargeters. Need keyword list, creative plan, pacing, LP microcopy, and routing.
Marta: Budget?
Alex: $6.8k total. Burn plan: 50% first 9h, 30% next 12h, 20% final window. Target blended CPA <$42.
Samir: Ill do pacing and automation. Ladder with 3 bid bands + adaptive reassign every 3h. If CPA > $55 for 2h, pause lowest band and throttle. Will post hourly telemetry.
Olivia: Creative plan: 3 variants: A) "Latency-first" 6s loop gif, B) "Outcome" stat card, C) "Technical" micro-demo (9s). Mobile-first copy, CTA variations: "Save my seat" / "Reserve a spot". Uploading to /design/ads/weekend_lift by 3pm.
Jen: Landing page tweaks: headline -> \"See production LLM inference in 30 minutes\". Add micro-benchmark blurb under form: \"Avg latency 30-60ms in production\". Add hidden `lead_source=weekend_lift` and `utm_enforced=true`.
Alex: Use UTM template:
```
utm_source=google&utm_medium=cpc&utm_campaign=weekend_lift_jun&utm_content={variant}
```
Samir: Retarget windows: 7d site visitors (broad), 14d video viewers (>25%) for mid-funnel, 3d CTA clickers for hard retarget. Exclude 60d converters. Also create 1% lookalike from last 30d signups at 12% of budget.
Marta: Keyword strategy? longtail vs competitor?
Olivia: Prioritize longtail purchase-intent phrases: \"deploy llm inference api\", \"low latency model serving\", \"production llm endpoint\". Keep branded exact-match. Competitor set for top-funnel tests only. Negative list: \"free weights\", \"open weights\", \"chatbot templates\".
Samir: Placement exclusions: block low-quality feeds and in-app placements. Apply -12% display modifier and -18% for networks with past high CPA. Adaptive bid floors: reduce bids 15% for keywords with CTR <0.6% after 4h.
Jen: Forms: hidden fields `utm_campaign=weekend_lift_jun` and `lead_source=weekend_lift`. Webhook to /ops/webinar-sync to auto-create SFDC lead and tag webinar queue. Also adding server-side UTM validation to cut bots.
Alex: Geo: US + CA. Daypart 06:00-22:00 local. Frequency cap 3 impressions/day on top groups.
Olivia: Creative rollout: start 40/40/20 A/B/C. After 10h, move 75% to winner if sample >200 clicks. Mobile creatives use shortened CTA "Save my seat".
Samir: Pacing script config snippet:
```
spend_curve = [0.5, 0.3, 0.2]
reassign_interval_hours = 3
cpa_fallback_threshold = 55
```
I'll tag campaign with `campaign_type:weekend_lift`.
Marta: Finance sign-off?
FinanceBot: Budget approved $6,800. Alert set at 85% of initial tranche.
Alex: Also need a one-paragraph benchmark narrative skeleton for the post-burst summary: 1) baseline CPA/CTR/CVR, 2) retarget audience sizes, 3) creative winner note, 4) any sample-size caveats. Marta can draft?
Marta: I can draft the narrative doc and include historical baselines from last 3 weekend tests.
Jen: LP perf: images lazy-loaded and critical CSS inlined. CDN purge queued. Ill validate that form webhook returns 200 before go.
Samir: Deploying monitoring. AdOpsBot will post hourly: spend, CPA, CTR, top creative. Auto-throttle if projected CPA > $55 for 2h.
AdOpsBot: Campaign tag received: `campaign:weekend_lift_jun`. Monitoring enabled. Will post first-hour burn and hourly KPIs.
Olivia: Assets uploaded: `/design/ads/weekend_lift/gif_latency_v1.gif`, `/design/ads/weekend_lift/stat_outcome_v1.png`, `/design/ads/weekend_lift/demo_9s_v1.mp4`.
Alex: Small ask on copy: for technical audiences in competitor-keyword groups include one-line: "Works with quantized & int8 flows for lower cost".
Olivia: Added as a variant in C.
Samir: Also creating retarget audience exports: will attach CSVs at close (7d_visitors.csv, 14d_video.csv, 3d_clickers.csv) and counts in the debrief.
Jen: Form validation done. Webhook returns 200 and SFDC mapping tested in staging. Hidden field `lead_source=weekend_lift` verified.
Marta: Approve A/B cadence. Move 75% to winner after 10h if significance hit and sample >=200 clicks; otherwise extend to 16h.
Alex: Great. Everyone react when live. Ill launch Saturday 06:00 PT. Debrief doc due within 24h after close with benchmark narrative + retarget CSVs + creative-level CPA.
Olivia: creative A/B live
Samir: pacing + monitoring live
Jen: LP live + webhook verified
Marta: budget live
AdOpsBot: Live monitoring started. Hour 0 burn: $3,400 (50% first tranche). Posting hourly KPIs and will raise alert if spend > 85% of first tranche before 9h.
Alex: Thanks team. Post-burst, include a short note on any channel friction (feed blocks, low-quality placements) so we can refine placement exclusions for next window.
